seen: Satellite z19 mosaic (0.237 m/px): a long wooded wedge (~165 m NW-SE, up to ~95 m wide) between the 4-lane road on the NE (with a sidewalk, not traced), a house-lined alley with parking on the SW/W and the south road. The OSM outline (px ~670-1378 x 1055-1641) runs over the NE road and south road edges, so the traced park stops at the visible curbs/sidewalks. Near the NW-middle stands a large brown pyramid-roof building with a skylight (~21 m square, x 952-1040 y 1355-1447) tagged amenity=toilets '야외화장실' with small white-roofed sheds on its NW: building, not traced. A grey block plaza runs along its south wall and south to a square with a framed planting bed and an arch-shaped loop path. A fenced dark-green hard court with white lines (~21 x 23.5 m, inner box like a badminton/족구 court) sits south-east of it with light walks on its west and south. A small grey rest corner lies NW of the building; a bare-earth clearing and a dirt trail are in the east wood. Everything else is dense canopy (NW strip, east and south-west woods); paths under canopy are inferred. No playground, no 정자/pergola and no benches resolvable. Trees are left to trees.py.
